title: "Runtime and Ratings"
---

::: {#43ebf1cb .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```
:::


This page examines the relationship between film runtime and IMDb rating. @fig-runtime-rating shows how ratings vary across films with different runtimes.

::: {#cell-fig-runtime-rating .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb rating")
plt.show()
```

## Mean rating by decade

::: {#7f9af8e5 .cell execution_count=3}
``` {.python .cell-code}
films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
```
